atoms.text: This huge city is located on the east coast of North America and has almost 9 million citizens. It has the nickname “Big Apple”. The name was originated by jazz musicians in the early twentieth century. The original name of this city was New Amsterdam, but it was renamed, as New York, in 1664.

atoms.b: New York is a huge ((city)) in the USA. The ((mayor)) is responsible for the whole city. Looking at the skyline of New York, you will see a few ((landmarks)), like the Empire State Building.  When you are visiting New York City, you can use the ((subway)) to explore the city.

The city has a big ((population)) and many ((neighbourhoods)), like Chinatown, Harlem or Little Italy. If you want to go shopping, you can find many ((department_stores)). Besides beautiful ((monuments)), New York also has some ((run-down)) buildings, that nobody wants to see.
